faces.name: Teferi's Puzzle Box
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player puts the cards in their hand on the bottom of their library in any order, then draws that many cards.

faces.name: Teferi's Realm
faces.oracleText: At the beginning of each player's upkeep, that player chooses artifact, creature, land, or non-Aura enchantment. All nontoken permanents of that type phase out. (While they're phased out, they're treated as though they don't exist. Each one phases in before its controller untaps during their next untap step.)

faces.name: Teferi's Reproach
faces.oracleText:
Choose target opponent. Until that player's next turn, they gain protection from everything and their life total can't change. All nonland permanents they control phase out. (While they're phased out, they're treated as though they don't exist. They phase in before that player untaps during their next untap step.)
Exile Teferi's Reproach.

faces.name: Teferi's Response
faces.oracleText:
Counter target spell or ability an opponent controls that targets a land you control. If a permanent's ability is countered this way, destroy that permanent.
Draw two cards.

faces.name: Teferi's Sentinel
faces.oracleText: As long as you control a Teferi planeswalker, this creature gets +4/+0.

faces.name: Teferi's Talent
faces.oracleText:
Enchant planeswalker
Enchanted planeswalker has "[−12]: You get an emblem with 'You may activate loyalty abilities of planeswalkers you control on any player's turn any time you could cast an instant.'"
Whenever you draw a card, put a loyalty counter on enchanted planeswalker.

faces.name: Teferi's Time Twist
faces.oracleText: Exile target permanent you control. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step. If it enters as a creature, it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.

faces.name: Teferi's Tutelage
faces.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, draw a card, then discard a card.
Whenever you draw a card, target opponent mills two cards. (They put the top two cards of their library into their graveyard.)
